'''XP-MU 3376''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Asteroid Mining Unit]]. It was deployed in close proximity to [[Outpost AS-27]], an [[Asteroid Hangar]], and was set up in line with [[Processing Plant]] [[AL-82673]].
